How often a sensor revisits the same place (revisit time).
The number and narrowness of the wavelength bands a sensor records.

front: Number of brightness levels for n bits?

back: NIR shown as red, red as green, green as blue; healthy vegetation looks bright red, water dark.
Size, shape, tone (colour), texture, pattern and context (association, shadow).
Supervised: analyst supplies training samples. Unsupervised: software groups similar pixels, the analyst names the groups.

front: Steps from raw band to map?
back: Acquire, pre-process (geometric and atmospheric), enhance, composite, classify, check accuracy, produce map.

front: Why do spatial and temporal resolution trade off?
back: Fine pixels cover small areas and are revisited less often; frequent coverage usually has coarser pixels.
